name: Hopeless
overview: Scripture reveals that hopelessness is overcome through the assurance of God's attentive care and sovereign plans for His people. The righteous can cry out in trouble, confident that the Lord hears and delivers them, offering peace that surpasses worldly understanding. God’s promises, including the gift of everlasting life through Christ and the witness of the Spirit affirming our identity as His children, provide a firm foundation of hope grounded in His power and loving intentions.
